checks.text: The page shows the heading "Word Scramble Game", the text "No active round", and the score display "Score: 0".

With the field labelled "Seed" set to "42" and the select labelled "Difficulty" set to "Easy", clicking the button "Start round" shows the text "Round started", a timer displaying "00:30", and the scrambled word "ELP".

After starting a round with Seed "42" and Difficulty "Easy", typing "HELP" in the field labelled "Answer" and clicking the button "Submit" shows the toast "Correct! +10 points", updates the score display to "Score: 10", and displays the next scrambled word "WORLD".

After starting a round with Seed "42" and Difficulty "Easy", typing "HELQ" in the field labelled "Answer" and clicking the button "Submit" shows the toast "Incorrect", keeps the score display at "Score: 0", and keeps the scrambled word "ELP".
After starting a round with Seed "42" and Difficulty "Easy", clicking the button "Pause" changes the button label to "Resume" and stops the timer at its current value, e.g., "00:25".

After starting a round with Seed "42" and Difficulty "Easy", clicking the button "Give up" shows the toast "Round over", displays the text "Final score: 0", and updates the "Best score" display to "Best: 0".

After starting a round with Seed "42" and Difficulty "Easy", solving the first word "HELP" to reach "Score: 10", then reloading the page, the page still shows the text "Round started", the scrambled word "WORLD", and the score display "Score: 10".

After starting a round with Seed "42" and Difficulty "Easy", solving the first word "HELP" to reach "Score: 10", then clicking the button "Restart", the page shows the text "No active round", the score display "Score: 0", and the "Best score" display "Best: 10".
